assumptions: differentiable atomic readout with fixed external sensitivities
same source, observer and operational calibration
external total sensitivities with a valid weak-field neighborhood
cross_probe_constraint: DeltaQ*z+K*eta=0; necessary, not sufficient without the inverse-image and validity conditions

follow_on.reentry: The specified matched packet, or an exact error in this source/calibration/algebra audit. A new candidate or TECT model adoption requires separate authorization.

identifiability: For pinned qS>0,qbar>=0 and a nonzero contrast, recover d^2 from admissible C; sign remains unidentified. Unknown source sensitivity or vanishing contrasts add non-identifiability.
non_claims: No A/B gate closure or physical-empty sign
No spacetime, QFT, gravity, horizon, common causal cone, continuum, mass gap or TOE derivation
No empirical detection or exclusion without controlled same-source data and finite-response errors
No novel theorem claim for standard scalar EFT or rational algebra

scope.boundary: asymptotically zero massless unscreened scalar; no incoming/DM oscillation
scope.normalization: same actual mean of A/B inward accelerations, exact Newtonian denominator
scope.regulator_volume_limit: no lattice or TECT continuum/volume limit; first weak-potential response at fixed coupling only
scope.source: one static spherical weak source, fixed outward radial convention
scope.time: external metric proper time for atomic phases; no Markov conversion

single_missing_input: Matched same-source observation/calibration/error packet for z, eta and total clock/mass sensitivities, including finite-response remainder and withheld-data roles.
stability: Fixed-charge inverse bound only away from zero source/contrast and denominator margins; material and finite-response errors remain missing.
terminal_scope: Conditional Newtonian first-response benchmark only; not full-action well-posedness or finite-experiment admission

verification.independent_review: Two read-only agents plus non-importing implementation; not independent-person certification
